name: Moon Clash Heroes 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Moon Clash Heroes is a futuristic third-person shooter game with robot soldiers and other high-tech weapons, such as a Tesla-type lighting gun and strike bot. This game is part of the series, you can check out the other games, such as Airport Clash 3D and Ninja Clash Heroes among others.
